newsitem.title: DENMARK: POLL-NOVO H1 97 PROFIT SEEN 8.6 PCT HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: POLL-NOVO H1 97 PROFIT SEEN 8.6 PCT HIGHER.

text.p: Seven analysts polled by Reuters on Monday forecast that Danish biotechnological group Novo Nordisk will announce first-half 1997 operating profits 8.6 percent up on the same 1996 period.
The panel foresaw an average operating profit of 1.244 billion crowns, compared to 1996's interim 1.145 billion with estimates in the 1.180 to 1.287 billion crown range.
Novo Nordisk's own forecast is for a 15 percent better interim operating profit.
The analysts also predicted pre-tax profits for the half year of an average 1.272 billion crowns, against 1.229 billion a year ago.
Novo Nordisk announces its first-half 1997 result on August 13. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
